root_cause.text: In the rtw88 wifi driver, rtw_core_enable_beacon() incorrectly used 32-bit register accessors on REG_TXPAUSE at offset 0x522, an unaligned register address, causing alignment faults on architectures that require 4-byte alignment.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes only the REG_TXPAUSE accesses in rtw_core_enable_beacon() from rtw_write32_set/clr() to rtw_write8_set/clr(), and the crash log shows rtw_pci_read32/32-bit access at address ending in 0x522 with “alignment fault,” while the commit message explicitly says it “reads 4 bytes from an address that is not a multiple of 4.”

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In the rtw88 wifi driver, rtw_core_enable_beacon() incorrectly used 32-bit register accessors on REG_TXPAUSE at offset 0x522, an unaligned register address, causing alignment faults on architectures that require 4-byte alignment.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes only the REG_TXPAUSE accesses in rtw_core_enable_beacon() from rtw_write32_set/clr() to rtw_write8_set/clr(), and the crash log shows rtw_pci_read32/32-bit access at address ending in 0x522 with “alignment fault,” while the commit message explicitly says it “reads 4 bytes from an address that is not a multiple of 4.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix beacon enable/disable TX pause handling by updating REG_TXPAUSE with 8-bit accesses instead of incorrect 32-bit operations.
intent_record.what: The change replaces two 32-bit register bit updates on REG_TXPAUSE with 8-bit variants in rtw_core_enable_beacon(): rtw_write32_clr(...) becomes rtw_write8_clr(...) when enabling beacons, and rtw_write32_set(...) becomes rtw_write8_set(...) when disabling beacons.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the code now modifies only the low 8-bit portion of the REG_TXPAUSE register when toggling BIT_HIGH_QUEUE, instead of performing a 32-bit read-modify-write on the whole register. This avoids unintended changes to adjacent bits or fields in the wider register and makes the TX pause control match the register's intended access width.

grouping_result.intent: Fix beacon enable/disable TX pause handling by updating REG_TXPAUSE with 8-bit accesses instead of incorrect 32-bit operations.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the root cause by replacing incorrect 32-bit accesses to the unaligned REG_TXPAUSE register at 0x522 with 8-bit accesses in beacon enable/disable handling, preventing alignment faults.

candidates.rationale: This directly performs a 32-bit register access on REG_TXPAUSE, which is at unaligned offset 0x522, causing the alignment fault described in the root cause.
This also directly performs a 32-bit register access on the unaligned REG_TXPAUSE register at offset 0x522, embodying the same root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement performs a 32-bit clear operation on REG_TXPAUSE, which is located at unaligned offset 0x522. Using a 32-bit accessor on this register can trigger alignment faults on architectures that require 4-byte alignment.

This statement performs a 32-bit set operation on REG_TXPAUSE at unaligned offset 0x522. It shares the same root cause of using an incorrect 32-bit register accessor on an unaligned address, leading to possible alignment faults.
